questions.question: Why wait with block_until_ready when timing a computation?
options: To include completion of device work in elapsed time
questions.explanation: Without waiting, elapsed time can primarily measure dispatch rather than the completion of the numerical work.
optionFeedback: Waiting changes when the host proceeds, not the derivative. Compare the numerical results before and after synchronization.
Without waiting, elapsed time can primarily measure dispatch rather than the completion of the numerical work.
Synchronization waits for completion; it does not choose or constrain the answer. Without it, a timer can mostly measure dispatch.
